item.title: Maura Balocco – Integrated Psycho-Medicine
item.description:
🛠️ Description

Official website developed for Maura Balocco, clinical psychologist, author and researcher in integrated psycho-medicine.

The goal of the project was to create a highly personal and emotionally coherent online presence, able to communicate:

  • sensitivity
  • authenticity
  • human connection
  • trust
  • intuitive approach

The entire website was built with Hugo, using a fully custom structure without relying on traditional CMS platforms.

Special attention was dedicated to:

  • visual harmony
  • mobile experience
  • editorial content structure
  • book integration
  • social and video presence
  • readability and atmosphere

The project required extensive refinement work to balance the artistic identity of the client with modern UX principles and usability.

item.title: Assembler Studio
item.description:
🧠 Description

Assembler Studio is the official portfolio website of Assembler Computer, designed to showcase and enhance the web projects developed over time, with a technical, minimal, and user experience-oriented approach.

It’s not just another showcase site, but a structured project that reflects the Assembler workflow:
clarity, full code control, top performance, and functional design.

Built entirely with Hugo, with no pre-made themes, to ensure maximum creative freedom, a solid base, and full scalability.
